Local changes vs upstream (https://github.com/rmn20/MascotME):

- src/com/mascotcapsule/micro3d/v3/MascotME.java:
    useArrayCopyClear: false -> true
    overwrite2D:      false -> true
  Both are safe performance hacks (see INI-CONFIG.md) and are enabled by
  default for the GB300/SF2000 build. Per-game overrides still work via a
  mascotme.ini placed in the game JAR root.
